d: Mexico—a land home to the mysterious cities of the Aztec and Maya civilizations, where the iconic Chichén Itzá stands as one of the Seven Wonders of the World. It is a place defined by the vibrant melodies of Mariachi music and the colorful masks of Lucha Libre; a land where you can savor the taste of tacos and discover the sweet origins of chocolate. There is so much more to Mexico—things you truly ought to know. So, join us on a journey to Mexico, right here on Infinity Stream!
